strengths: Third independent corroboration of the paraphrase-then-second-clause quotation nesting move, this time with a reporter's own interpretive clause rather than a second quotation as the second layer — evidence the underlying discipline (attribute the words, then let a separate clause carry interpretation) is a flexible News convention, not one fixed sentence template.
weaknesses: The idiomatic predicate '화두를 던지다' is this outlet's own colorful word choice for this story, not observed at the other outlets covering the same event — do_not_copy as a general predicate-choice norm.
